description: Dependency updates (docs/spec/11-engineering.md §8, 08 §6). Nothing is ever automerged.

customManagers.description: Images pinned in .gitlab-ci.yml variables, each annotated `# renovate: datasource=docker depName=…` on the line above.

Versions pinned in CI scripts (the mise release). A mise bump also needs the new SHA-256 values from the release's signed SHASUMS256 committed next to it, or install-mise.sh fails the pipeline; Renovate can't do that, so mise has its own group.

packageRules.description: pnpm-workspace.yaml's allowBuilds names esbuild by exact version (M2a review S-5).
prBodyNotes: Edit the `esbuild@<version>: true` key under `allowBuilds` in pnpm-workspace.yaml to the new version, or esbuild's install script stops running.

packageRules.description: One update for every pin of the same tool, across mise.toml, the Dockerfile, the CI images and packageManager; pnpm lint:pins fails when they differ. Renovate refreshes mise.lock with the mise.toml change (its mise manager runs mise lock).
The mise release needs its checksums updated by hand (scripts/ci/install-mise.sh), so it never holds up other updates.
Kaniko comes from a community fork (F-10): read its release notes before merging.
Game packages installed through instance.config.ts (generated by pnpm renovate:sync): read the diff with the trust model in mind (02 §7.5).
